spans.s: व्य्-उप्त. See s. v.

व्युप्त व्य्-उप्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. वि-वप्), scat-
tered about, disordered, dishevelled.
—व्युप्त-केश,
अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having dishevelled hair; (अस्), m. epi-
thet of Rudra and Fire (as identified with Rudra).
व्य्-उष्ट. See under 2. व्य्-उष्.

1. व्युष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, burnt, (perhaps to be
written व्य्-उष्ट, see above.)

2. व्य्-उष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, dawned, become day-light
or dawn; become bright or clear; (अम्), n. dawn,
day-break (personified as a son of Kalpa, in which
case to be regarded as masc.), day; fruit, result,
consequence.

3. व्य्-उष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, dwelt, lodged; passed;
one who has passed a night or lodged for a night.
व्य्-उषित, व्य्-उष्ट, &c. See s. v.
1. व्य्-उषित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = 2. व्य्-उष्ट below.

व्युषित 2. व्य्-उषित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 3. वि-
वस्), lived away, dwelling abroad; dwelt, lodged,
passed (e. g. व्य्-उषितो रात्रिम्, he lodged for a
night, i. e. he passed or spent a night).
—व्युषि-
ताश्व (˚त-अश्˚), अस्, m., N. of a king descended
from Daśa-ratha.
व्य्-ऊढ. See s. v.

व्यूढ 1. व्य्-ऊढ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. वि-वह्),
married. (For 2. व्य्-ऊढ see under व्य्-ऊह्.)

2. व्य्-ऊढ, अस्, आ, अम्, placed or moved apart,
widely separated, expanded, developed, wide, broad;
large, great, firm, compact; placed in order or array,
arrayed, marshalled, arranged; placed out of order,
disarranged, transposed, altered.
—व्यूढ-कङ्कट,
अस्, आ, अम्, one who has arranged or put on armour,
equipped in mail, accoutred, mailed, armed.
—व्यू-
ढ-छन्दस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. having the metres
disarranged or out of order.
—व्यूढोरस्, आस्, आस्,
अस्, or व्यूढोरस्क (˚ढ-उर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having
an expanded chest, broad-chested, (व्यूढ = विपुल,
comm.)
व्य्-ऊत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. interwoven, &c. See s. v.

व्य्-ऊत, अस्, आ, अम्, interwoven, &c. = व्य्-उत
above.
व्यूत व्य्-ऊत, व्य्-ऊति. See under व्य्-उत.

व्युत व्य्-उत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. वि-वे), inter-
woven, woven, sewn; separated, (Sāy. = विविक्त);
stretched out, expanded, (according to Sāy. in this
sense fr. rt. व्ये.)

व्य्-उत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, well sprinkled or wetted,
drenched.

व्यु व्य्-उ (वि-उ), cl. 5. P. -उनोति, Ved. to
urge on, drive forward; to incite, animate, (Sāy. =
प्रेरयति, Ṛg-veda

व्युक्ष् व्य्-उक्ष् (वि-उक्ष्, see rt. 1. उक्ष्), cl.
6. P. A. -उक्षति, -ते, -उक्षितुम्, Ved. to sprinkle
or pour out; to drip or flow or trickle over (A.).

व्युच्चर् व्य्-उच्-चर् (वि-उद्-चर्), cl. 1. P. A.
-चरति, -ते, -चरितुम्, to go forth in different direc-
tions; to go out of the right path; to transgress or
offend against, be faithless or disloyal towards (with
acc.); to commit adultery with (with inst.).

व्य्-उच्चरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, offending against, being
faithless towards (with acc.); committing adultery.

व्य्-उच्चरमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, offending against,
being faithless towards (with acc.).
व्युच्छत् व्य्-उच्छत्. See 2. व्य्-उष्, 3. वि-वस्.

व्य्-उच्छत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. shining forth,
dawning, (according to Sāy. व्युच्छन्ती = तमो
वर्जयन्ती, Ṛg-veda

व्युच्छिद् व्य्-उच्-छिद् (वि-उद्-छिद्), cl. 7. P. A.
-छिनत्ति, -छिन्त्ते, -छेत्तुम्, to cut entirely off,
extirpate, cut up, destroy: Pass. -छिद्यते (ep. also
[]
P. -छिद्यति), to be entirely cut off, be extirpated;
to be interrupted, come to an end, become extinct,
cease, fail.

व्य्-उच्छित्ति, इस्, f. cutting off, cutting away, cutting
short, destruction, rooting up, extirpation.

व्य्-उच्छिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, cut off, extirpated, com-
pletely destroyed, interrupted, come to an end, ceased.

व्य्-उच्छेत्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, who or what cuts off or
destroys, a destroyer.

व्य्-उच्छेद, अस्, m. cutting off, cutting short, de-
struction.
व्य्-उति, इस्, f. interweaving, weaving, sewing.
व्य्-ऊति, इस्, f. = व्य्-उति above.

व्युत्क्रम् व्य्-उत्-क्रम् (वि-उद्-क्रम्), cl. 1. P.
A. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्रमितुम्, to go apart
or in different directions, go in a wrong direction,
go astray; to go or pass by, go beyond, overstep,
deviate, go out of the right way, transgress; to dis-
regard, neglect; to go away, depart, leave.

व्य्-उत्क्रम, अस्, m. going astray or out of the
right course, going or passing beyond, transgression,
inverted order, reverse or irregular arrangement, de-
rangement, disorder, confusion, contrariety.

व्य्-उत्क्रम्य, ind. having gone forth, having
left; having passed by or gone beyond.

व्य्-उत्क्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, gone asunder, gone
forth, departed, left; passed by, gone beyond, over-
stepped, transgressed, disregarded, neglected; (आ), f.
a kind of riddle or enigma.
—व्युत्क्रान्त-धर्म,
अस्, आ, अम्, one who has overstepped his duty, neg-
lectful of duty.
—व्युत्क्रान्त-रजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, one
whose impurity has gone away, free from passion.
—व्युत्क्रान्त-वर्त्मन्, आ, आ, अ, one who has gone
beyond the right path.

व्य्-उत्क्रामत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going asunder, going
forth.

व्युत्था व्य्-उत्-था (वि-उद्-स्था), Caus. -था-
पयति, -यितुम्, to cause to rise up, stir up, excite
greatly, rouse, instigate, incite, irritate.

व्य्-उत्थान, अम्, n. ‘excessive rising up,’ great
activity; a kind of dancing or gesticulation; rising
up against, opposition, contradiction, doing anything
prohibited, obstruction, hindering; separate or indi-
vidual exertion, independent action, following one's
own inclination; the completion of a religious act or
vow (as of contemplation or abstraction).

व्य्-उत्थापित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to rise up, roused,
brought up.

व्युत्पद् व्य्-उत्-पद् (वि-उद्-पद्), cl. 4. A.
-पद्यते, -पत्तुम्, to arise or originate clearly or
in any well ascertained manner, to be produced from
or out of; to originate; (in grammar) to be derived
(from a root &c.); to have an etymology; to be
an accomplished scholar, become perfectly proficient
in or conversant with: Caus. -पादयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to issue out of, produce, cause; (in gram-
mar) to derive, trace back to a root &c.

व्य्-उत्पत्ति, इस्, f. production, origin, derivation
(especially of words from roots &c.), etymology; per-
fection, completion, perfect conversancy with or pro-
ficiency in (literature or science); scholarship, learn-
ing.
—व्युत्पत्ति-पक्षे, ind. on the side of deri-
vation or etymology (an expression used by Vedic
commentators when the accentuation is settled by
the affixes and not according to the meaning of
the words).

व्य्-उत्पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, produced, generated,
begotten; derived (from a root &c.; अ-व्युत्पन्-
नम्, an underived or primitive word); formed (as a
derivative word); completed, perfected, finished, ac-
complished; quite conversant with or proficient in
(literature &c.); learned.

व्य्-उत्पादक, अस्, इका, अम्, giving rise to, pro-
[]
ducing, originating, productive; tracing or forming
(words).

व्य्-उत्पाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, derivable, deducible,
capable of being formed &c.

व्य्-उत्पित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid.), desirous of
making proficiency (in any science).

व्युत्सद् व्य्-उत्-सद् (वि-उद्-), cl. 1. P. -सीदति,
-सत्तुम्, to be unsettled; to be upset or overthrown.

व्युद् व्य्-उद् or व्य्-उन्द् (वि-उद्, &c.), cl. 7. P.
-उनत्ति, -उन्दितुम्, Ved. to spring or gush forth; to
wet or sprinkle thoroughly, water, drench.

व्य्-उन्दत्, अन्, अती, अत्, Ved. wetting thoroughly,
sprinkling.

व्य्-उन्दन, अम्, n. the act of well moistening or
wetting.

व्युदस् व्य्-उद्-अस् (वि-उद्-), cl. 4. P. -अस्यति,
-असितुम्, to throw or scatter about, cast in every
direction; to throw off, cast off, reject, lay aside,
give up, abandon, exclude.

व्य्-उदस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or scattered about,
cast off, put off, thrown aside.

व्य्-उदस्य, ind. having thrown or scattered in all
directions, having thrown off or put away, having
thrown aside or abandoned.

व्य्-उदास, अस्, m. throwing or scattering in dif-
ferent directions, throwing away or aside, rejection,
exclusion (in grammar); prohibition; disregard for,
indifference to.

व्युदित व्य्-उदित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वद् with
वि), disputed, debated, discussed, contested.

व्युदूह् व्य्-उद्-ऊह् (वि-उद्-), cl. 1. P. -ऊहति,
-ऊहितुम्, Ved. to push apart or asunder, move away,
move out, remove; to sweep out or away.

व्य्-उदूह्य, ind. having moved or placed asunder,
having removed.

व्युपदेश व्य्-उपदेश, अस्, m. pretext, pre-
tence, plausible but false plea, deception.

व्युपनी व्य्-उप-नी (वि-उप-), cl. 1. P. A.
-नयति, -ते, -नेतुम्, Ved. to lead or bring sepa-
rately or one by one.

व्युपयुज् व्य्-उप-युज् (वि-उप-), cl. 7. A.
-युङ्क्ते, -योक्तुम्, to become closely attached, be
concerned about.

व्युपरम् व्य्-उप-रम् (वि-उप-), cl. 1. A. -र-
मते (ep. also P. -ति), -रन्तुम्, to leave off or
pause variously; to be at rest, be tranquil, have
repose; to cease, desist from (with abl.).

व्युपारम् व्य्-उपा-रम् (वि-उप-आ-), cl. 1. A.
-रमते (ep. P. -ति), -रन्तुम्, to desist from, leave
off, cease.

व्य्-उपरत, अस्, आ, अम्, paused, rested, stopped,
interrupted, ceased, desisted; calmed, tranquillized,
tranquil.
व्य्-उपरम, अस्, m. pause, cessation, interruption.

व्य्-उपरमम्, ind., Ved. leaving off or pausing
variously.

व्य्-उपरम्य, ind. having ceased or desisted
from (with abl.), having stopped.

व्युपशम व्य्-उपशम, अस्, m. non-cessation,
not ceasing or desisting; inquietude.

व्युपास् व्य्-उपास् (वि-उप-अस्), cl. 4. P. -उपास्-
यति, -उपासितुम्, to throw about, distribute.

व्युब्ज् व्य्-उब्ज् (वि-उब्ज्), cl. 6. P. -उब्जति,
-उब्जितुम्, Ved. to uncover, open, display.

व्युष् 1. व्युष् (also read प्युष्), cl. 4.
P. व्युष्यति, &c., to burn, (in this sense
perhaps for rt. 1. उष् with वि); to divide, distribute,
[]
(in this sense also written प्युस्, पुष्, ब्युस्, बुस्);
cl. 10. P. व्योषयति, -यितुम्, to reject, discharge,
emit, (in this sense also written पुस्.)

व्युष् 2. व्य्-उष् (for 1. वि-वस्, q. v., cf.
2. उष्), cl. 6. P. -उच्छति, &c., Ved. to shine forth,
shine, dawn, arise.

3. व्य्-उष्, f., Ved. shining forth, dawning, (ac-
cording to Sāy. व्युषि = व्युच्छने सति, Ṛg-veda
, = विवासने or प्रकाशने सति, Ṛg-veda
व्युस् व्युस्. See rt. ब्युस्.

व्य्-उच्छन, अम्, n. shining forth, opening, mani-
festation.

व्य्-उष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. the rising or breaking of
dawn, dawn; increase, prosperity, felicity; fruit,
consequence; a hymn, praise.

व्य्-उष्य, ind. having dwelt, having lodged, hav-
ing passed or spent (e. g. रात्रिं व्य्-उष्य, having
spent a night).

व्यूर्णु व्य्-ऊर्णु (वि-ऊर्णु), cl. 2. P. A. -ऊर्णोति
or -ऊर्णौति, -ऊर्णुते, -ऊर्णवितुम् or -ऊर्णुवितुम्,
Ved. to uncover, open out, open; to display.

व्य्-ऊर्ण्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, Ved. uncovering, dis-
playing, revealing.

व्यूह् व्य्-ऊह् (वि-ऊह्, see rt. 1. ऊह्), cl. 1. P.
-ऊहति, -ऊहितुम्, to push or move apart, place
asunder, separate, divide, distribute; to separate,
resolve (vowels, syllables, &c. in Vedic grammar);
to dispose, arrange, place in order; to array, to place
in battle-array, arrange in order of battle; to move
from the proper place, change the position, trans-
pose, alter, disarrange.

व्य्-ऊढि, इस्, f. orderly arrangement or disposition,
distribution in various positions, array.

व्य्-ऊह, अस्, m. placing apart, separation, distribu-
tion; separation or resolution (of vowels, syllables,
&c. in Vedic grammar); orderly arrangement, dis-
position, array (e. g. चरण-व्यूह, array of Vedic
schools), military array, (various forms of array are
enumerated in Manu
VII. 187

and elsewhere, e. g.
दण्ड, that like ‘a staff;’ शकट, ‘a cart;’ व-
राह, ‘a boar;’ मकर, ‘a sea-monster;’ सूचि,
[]
‘a needle;’ गरुड, ‘the bird of Viṣṇu;’ वज्र,
‘a thunderbolt;’ भोग, ‘a snake,’ i. e. in column;
मण्डल, ‘a circle;’ असंहत, ‘mixed order;’
पताक, ‘a flag,’ &c.); an army, host, squadron; a
flock, multitude; (in phil.) arrangement or peculiar
distribution (of the senses); formation, structure, manu-
facture; the body; reasoning, logic, (in this sense
rather to be derived fr. rt. 2. ऊह् with वि); breathing
(according to the Nyāya-sūtras
III. 31

).
—व्यूह-
पार्ष्णि, इस्, m. the rear of an army (= प्रत्य्-
आसार).
—व्यूह-भङ्ग or व्यूह-भेद, अस्, m.
breaking an array, throwing into disorder.
—व्यूह-
रचना, f. arrangement of troops.
—व्यूह-राज,
अस्, m. the chief or best form of military array.
—व्यूहान्तर (˚ह-अन्˚), अस्, m. a different ar-
rangement or position.

व्य्-ऊहत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, separating, dividing; dis-
posing, arranging, putting in military array.

व्य्-ऊहन, अम्, n. the act of disposing in order,
arrangement, arraying, array (of an army); dispo-
sition or structure of the members of the body.

व्य्-ऊह्य, ind. having disposed in order, having
arranged or arrayed, having placed in battle-array.
व्य्-उद or व्य्-उदक, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of water.

व्य्-उद्ग्रन्थन, अम्, n. the act of winding or
intertwining in various ways.
व्य्-उन्मिश्र, अस्, आ, अम्, intermixed, commingled.

व्य्-उपकार, अस्, m. making good, fulfilling, per-
formance.
व्यूक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
